purpose: Issue the first immutable non-agentic probabilistic forecast before B2 candidate/event enrichment and before any agentic residual experiment.

registered_N.sampler: Regenerate constrained logistic-normal slack draws from frozen per-territory floors/centres and region/local scales; every draw is 92 positive integers summing exactly to the national total.
registered_N.later_official_counts: Require a new snapshot; F-1 is never overwritten.

valid_vote_observation_model.local: For each territory compute 2011 valid-list votes divided by registered-times-turnout; winsorize at empirical p05/p95 and shrink 50% toward the national median. Simulated valid votes equal sampled N times sampled turnout times this frozen fraction.
valid_vote_observation_model.regional: Persist the 2021 regional-to-summed-local valid-vote ratio by region after empirical p05/p95 winsorization and 50% shrinkage toward 1.0; cap at sampled regional N.
valid_vote_observation_model.uncertainty: No additional invalid-ballot-rate shock in F-1; this is a disclosed structural limitation.

legal_party_mapping.other_rule: Split OTHER back into actual 2021 minor-party list codes in each contest, proportional to 2021 minor-party votes. If no minor-party history exists, fold OTHER back into core shares proportionally and record the event.
legal_party_mapping.future_new_lists: Excluded from F-1; verified 2026 entries belong to B2/F0 or later immutable snapshots.

integer_vote_model.method: Balanced randomized rounding: floor expected party counts and assign the exact remaining votes by Gumbel-top-k weighted by fractional remainders.
integer_vote_model.reason: Maintain exact valid-vote totals without deterministic party-label priority and retain only sub-vote observation noise.
integer_vote_model.statutory_tie_policy: If the legal allocator reaches a binding exact remainder tie without candidate-age evidence, rerandomize only the balanced vote rounding for that contest/draw, preserving latent shares and valid total. No party-name or raw-vote tie-break is allowed.
integer_vote_model.gate: Zero unresolved legal allocations after retries; rerounding incidence and attempts must be published.

regional_ballot_bridge.latent_shift: Same national and region vote innovations as local contests plus the mean sampled local residual within the region.
regional_ballot_bridge.limitation: No pre-2021 current-system regional-list transition exists; 2026 is the first prospective test.

required_invariants: 92 local N are positive integers and sum exactly to 15,801,162
all local and regional share vectors are finite, non-negative and sum to one
all simulated vote counts are non-negative integers and do not exceed registered N
all 104 contests allocate exactly their configured seats
every national draw sums to 395 seats
zero unresolved statutory ties after the frozen rerounding procedure
